audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Irelia wins Level 1 and 2+ items; the packet chart and the prose both say Urgot owns the start and the late game.
audit.why: Urgot's Purge (W) strafing plus Echoing Flames chunks Irelia while she last-hits at level 1, and at 2+ items his percent-HP output and Fear Beyond Death execute beat her ramp. Win rate 46.15% over 481 games supports Urgot-favoured.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 and 4-5 to Urgot, level 6 to Irelia (Vanguard's Edge walls off Disdain), 2+ items back to Urgot.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Urgot at levels 1-3 and 2+ items, Irelia at 6 with Vanguard's Edge and at first item.
audit.corrected: Sharpened level-6 phase text to name Disdain's 14s rank-5 cooldown as the bait target.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Disdain (E) shields Urgot as well as flipping — it eats Irelia's burst window, not just her positioning.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.' Cooldown 16/15.5/15/14.5/14.
audit.corrected: State the shield in the Don'ts and the Do's: the flip both cancels the Bladesurge chain and absorbs the burst, so commit only after it is spent.

audit.why: Disdain is correctly identified as the punishable cooldown; added the real number (14s at rank 5, 16s at rank 1).

edits.before: Stack passive on the wave before any trade. Identify how Urgot contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Stack passive on the wave and stay out of auto range. Purge strafing with Echoing Flames chunks you free while you last-hit.

edits.before: Vanguard’s Edge walls off his disengage and marks the kill. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Urgot's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Vanguard's Edge walls off Disdain, his only reposition — bait the 14s charge, wall behind him, then E-stun and Q-reset the kill.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Urgot carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, Urgot reclaims it: percent-HP shotguns out-grind your ramp and Fear Beyond Death executes you out of the dash chain.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it, then E-stun. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It shields him and flips you off your burst — engage after the charge is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Disdain shields him and cancels your burst; punish the 14s it is down.

notes: Full-layer and content-layer level charts both disagreed with the packet chart on rows 0, 3, 4, 6 — proposed as matched pairs. Urgot's Disdain shield was absent from every writable field; added to Do's and Don'ts.
